name: Azadi
en:
* You need to start play with Delhi and then control all India Regions (Bombay, Delhi, Central India, Bengal and Madras) with territory or vassals, including ports.
* While colonizing, you need to directly control the territory or you'll get unpassable terrain.
* Forming {{flag|India}} does not block this achievement provided it is formed by {{flag|Hindustan}}.
* You can actually start with EIC, raise your taxes and waiting for stability to drop, in the meantime annex as many vassals as you can. Right before civil war event pops up, give every possible province to Hindustan, and choose to play as Hindustan in the event. Save your game and reload, you'll see this achievement is able to unlock.
*The name of the achievement is Persian for \"freedom,\" \"liberty,\" or \"independence.\"
{{icon|poeb|w=36px}}

- id=\"Our Words are Backed\"

name: Our Words are Backed…
en:
* Gandhi spawns at some point in 1910 or later if there is Indian Pan Nationalism movement, you need to play as {{subject flag|East India|Great Britain|subject=BIC republic}} [[East India|British East India Company]] and remain UK subject to be eligible. Do not complete the Indian Home Rule Journal entry as this will change your country tag from BIC to BHT, making you ineligible for the event that spawns Gandhi.
* Another option is to play as {{subject flag|South Africa|Great Britain|subject=SAF ensign}} [[South Africa|Cape Colony]], where Gandhi can appear via an event beginning in 1893 if there are South Asian heritage pops in Zululand or the Eastern Cape. Additionally, your top overlord must be the same as that of {{subject flag|East India|Great Britain|subject=BIC republic}} [[East India|British East India Company]]. So if AI {{flag|Great Britain}} lets East India go free or shatter before you get Gandhi, the achievement becomes impossible. If they don't, keep in mind that you must have passed a law such as {{law|Multiculturalism|text=link}} to have him as ruler. 
* In both cases, Gandhi spawns as a {{ideology|Humanitarian leader}} agitator of the {{icon|Intelligentsia|3=1}} interest group, and will likely support the {{ideology|Liberal}} movement.
{{icon|poeb|w=36px}}

en:
* There's a chance for Kunduz to try to invade Kabul. Restart until this happens and then counter invade them.
* Another option is just to become a subject from Persia if you were attacked by Kunduz and then try to invade Kabul with an obligation to Persia as offer to join war.
* After that, just focus in military tech (for line infantry) and build military units and industry and you should be fine.
* Always check for the Intelligentsia leader in Kabul until you get the event, if it's not Harlan then restart

en:
There are many ways to do it. For example, you could start as Qing, damage relations with Russia, and then declare war on them. Raise as many conscripts as you can and set all your armies to attack. Then, simply wait.

- id=\"Champagne Socialist\"

name: Champagne Socialist
Fordlandia
en:
Since you need to be in top-10 GDPPC not global GDP, and engines industry is highly profitable when you switch to automated irrigation, it's easily doable with any country. Monopolies on rubber and monopolizing the Africa is an easy way to ensure you get it quickly. 
Note that the company requires researching combustion engine and having 5 levels of motors (trains) industries, not automobile industries.

- id=\"Swiss Bank Account\"

name: Swiss Bank Account
en:
{{collapse list|Cheese strategy|* (This method has likely become obsolete. As of 1.9.6, you cannot grant the two Switzerlands to {{flag|Sardinia-Piedmont}} or anyone since nobody would want them. A variant strategy is written at the end.)

** On game start, declare interests in Italy and Occitania, use Enlistment Efforts decrees on both your states and conscript the maximum amount of troops, then queue General Staff into Nationalism for research.

** When your interests have established, use a Power Bloc Embassy treaty to get money transfer (aim for ~2k) from any of the Sovereign Empire Power Bloc leaders that are protective towards you. Upon establishing this treaty, start a Diplomatic Play against Sardinia-Piedmont to conquer all of their states. For the war against Sardinia-Piedmont, you will likely have more success defending until you have General Staff, but with the conscription from National Militia you should be able to reduce their troop numbers more than they can reduce yours.

** After winning the war, incorporate Savoy and set an interest in Persia. Conquer Bahraini Hormuz from Bahrain. After conquering this state, incorporating Savoy, and researching Nationalism, change your capital to Savoy and release Sardinia-Piedmont as a subject. Grant it Sardinia and Provence, then use the Trade State interaction to give it East and West Switzerland. Declare war on France (Expel Diplomats if necessary) and they should set a \"Conquer Savoy\" wargoal as a primary. Back down to their demands and your capital will move to your only remaining state: Hormuz. Your GDP should be >10k at this point and you will be receiving ~2k in money transfer treaties so the achievement will pop.

* Alternatively, improve relations with all neighbors except {{flag|France}}. After annexing {{flag|Sardinia-Piedmont}}, build a power base, defeat France in a war to enforce maximum amount of money transfer (over 100k preferably), then release Sardinia and starve the two Switzerlands to death within 5 years. The GDP can be reduced to 1M and lower.}}

Starting as {{flag|Austria}}. Build ~ 100 {{iconify|Trade Center|building}}s in Venetia (You can also try less, the country with the most trade centers is Great Britain and they have about 70 at game start). Release and play as {{flag|Venice}}.

name: EXACTLY 100!!!
en:
Fervor is increased by having nationalistic citizenship laws ({{law|Ethnostate}} or {{law|National Supremacy}}), having high [[literacy]], lots of {{icon|academics|3=1}} and enacting {{law|Public Schools}}.
Realistically the main driver of the fervor is Literacy (25 from {{icon|academics|3=1}}, 25 from high [[literacy]], 25 from {{law|Public Schools}}), so you get 75 out of 100 with just that, so it's the most important aspect to work on. Remaining 25 fervor can be closed in different ways, the easiest one is losing people of primary culture in a war - it produces tons of fervor. It is percentage based, so small but literate countries (such as Italian minors) are good candidates from the campaign.

- id=\"Prussia of the Balkans\"

name: Prussia of the Balkans
en:
The easiest way to play Bulgaria is by starting as Russia, and immediately demanding them be liberated from the Ottomans (if you slap on a ton of other liberations too, they'll probably back down without a war). Once they're free an event will pop up to swap to them, but since you're playing as Russia you should trade them the rest of Dobruja before you swap (they should always accept). This route is slightly better than just releasing them as the ottomans, since you get a little more land. Alternatively, you could conquer the Bulgarian states from the Ottomans and then release and play as them, this avoids {{law|Slave Trade}} although you should probably get rid of {{law|Serfdom}} and {{law|Traditionalism}} before you release Bulgaria.

From there you just need to play Bulgaria relatively normally. You can cozy up to Russia to make sure nobody will kill you, but it's not too likely to begin with. Aim to build up your economy enough first to actually complete the Prussia of the Balkans JE; You can choose to either take the Yugoslav route, or gain a bunch of free claims on most European Ottoman land (this is probably better for the achievement).

You can use your big army + Russia to beat up the ottomans, giving you even more land to build up your economy, at least until you're a GP.

'''Alternatively''': Can be done during the course of a grand {{flag|Austria}} campaign where you form {{flag|Danubian State}}. Grab the Bulgarian homelands along the way or at the end. Beat up and balkanise which ever of {{flag|Prussia}}, {{flag|North German Federation}}, or {{flag|Germany}} exists if necessary. Then release and play as {{flag|Bulgaria}}. The achievement is easy from there.
{{icon|nawb|w=36px}}

- id=\"Quill and Bayonet\"

name: Quill and Bayonet
Sorbia is Serbia
en:
Both {{flag|Serbia}} and {{flag|Montenegro}} are potential starting countries. Can be combined with the \"David Slays Goliath\" achievement. It's arguably easier this way, because Montenegro gets a lot of military buffs that can help taking over Germany.

- id=\"Teamkiller\"

name: Teamkiller
en:
Forming Serbia and Montenegro is allowed.
Requirements to trigger the Balkan League can be found in the potential JE tab. The Spoils of War JE triggers after the Balkan wars. It used to be that you must not own all of your cultural homelands to trigger the JE, but this does not seem to be the case anymore.
{{icon|nawb|w=36px}}
